description: This source file implements WiFi configuration utilities for the prplMesh project, including functions to retrieve and set WiFi interface parameters, manage wireless settings, and handle MLD configurations.

methods.name: string_to_freq_type
methods.description: Converts a frequency string to an eFreqType enum value.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wifi_ssid_object
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID object for a given interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wifi_radio_object
methods.description: Retrieves the radio object for a given interface or radio object.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wifi_security_object
methods.description: Retrieves the security object for a given interface.

methods.name: cfg_get_all_prplmesh_wifi_interfaces
methods.description: Populates the list of WiFi interfaces with their parameters.

methods.name: cfg_get_wifi_params
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi parameters for a specific interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wifi_credentials
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi credentials for a specific interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_mld_info_config
methods.description: Retrieves MLD configuration info for a given SSID and MLD ID.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_set_wifi_credentials
methods.description: Sets WiFi credentials for a specific interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_mandatory_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves mandatory interfaces (not used in this implementation).

methods.name: cfg_get_sta_iface
methods.description: Gets the station interface associated with a given interface.

methods.name: cfg_get_hostap_iface
methods.description: Retrieves the hostap interface for a given radio number.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_monitored_BSSs_by_radio_iface
methods.description: Retrieves monitored BSSs for a radio interface (stub implementation).

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wpa_supplicant_ctrl_path
methods.description: Gets the control path for wpa_supplicant for a given interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_hostapd_ctrl_path
methods.description: Gets the control path for hostapd for a given interface.

methods.name: cfg_wifi_reset_wps_credentials
methods.description: Removes all WPS profiles to reset WPS credentials.
